cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Just Say Yes
cards.instruction: Get a quick approval before anyone has time to examine the practical consequences.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You gave the delivery men a thumbs-up, so I have too. Just say yes and I'll accept the sofa.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was pointing behind me at the door. Will it fit through there?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, the entrance first. Agree to the delivery and we can guide them through together.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They're getting a tape measure out.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then give me the yes before they come back with it. I'll meet them at the door; we should sound as certain as you looked.

reason: Replace detachable certainty with a specific copied misunderstanding that changes how A delays, seeks apology or assent, transfers responsibility, or retrieves a lost plan.
